summons: Chromatic Construct (Elemental Juggernaut top, level 7): HP 7 [square], Move 3 [square], Attack 0, Range - (melee); "Add +1 Attack for each element that is strong or waning."
Elemental Conduit (Ethereal Manifestation top, level 9): HP 3 [square], Move 3 [square], Attack 2, Range 3; Flying; "After each attack, infuse any."
mechanics: Wild element: consume any / infuse any (Ice Spikes top, Formless Power top+bottom, Flash of Brilliance bottom, Confluence of Elements top, Ethereal Manifestation bottom + Elemental Conduit, Primal Duality bottom)

Double consumes (two elements at once): Obsidian Shards top+bottom, Winter's Edge top+bottom, Confluence of Elements top (any+any x3), Primal Duality top (Fire+Ice, Air+Earth, Light+Dark) and bottom (any+any)

Split element icons (one pill with two half elements; GHS reads 'one of the two'): infuse Fire|Ice, Air|Earth, Light|Dark in turn (Pulsing Cores bottom), infuse in boxes (Pragmatic Reinforcement, Duskstorm, Elemental Juggernaut, Confluence of Elements bottoms), infuse inside consume rows (Obsidian Shards, Winter's Edge, Pragmatic Reinforcement, Duskstorm tops/bottoms), consume Air|Earth (Pragmatic Reinforcement top) and Fire|Ice (Duskstorm top)

Multi-element menu with a 'consume two or more' bonus: +1 Target and XP 1 (Malleable Evocation top, Shaping the Ether top), +1 Heal, XP 1, infuse Light (Prismatic Barrage bottom), +1 Attack, XP 1, infuse Dark (Eye of the Hurricane bottom)
+1 Move if one or more elements are strong or waning (Stoking Hail, Infernal Vortex, Frigid Torrent, Dual Nature bottoms); summon +1 Attack per strong or waning element (Chromatic Construct)

Element manipulation: move one waning element to strong (Malleable Evocation bottom); infuse an element whenever an enemy consumes it (Lingering Essence top, persistent); per-turn infusion track over six turns (Pulsing Cores bottom, slots, XP on 2/4/6)
Persistent start-of-turn consume: consume any for +1 Attack on all attacks that turn (Formless Power bottom)

Grant abilities to an ally: Move 2 + Jump (Magma Scales top), Shield 2 + Retaliate 2 (Magma Scales bottom, Primal Duality top), Move 2 + Shield 1 + Muddle adjacent (Gravel Guard top), Retaliate 2 range 2 with Ice (Empowering Flame bottom), Attack 3 (Winter's Edge bottom), Shield 2 to the heal target (Pragmatic Reinforcement top)

Recover cards: you or an ally recovers a level 1 card (Flash of Brilliance top), heal target recovers a level 1 card (Pragmatic Reinforcement top), recover any card from your discard (Primal Duality bottom); none of these halves is lost

Ward and Safeguard conditions (Malleable Evocation top, Arresting Gale bottom, Prismatic Barrage bottom); Bless on allies (Malleable Evocation top, Winter's Edge bottom, Prismatic Barrage bottom); Invisible on allies (Encompassing Shadow top, Duskstorm top for allies in the red hexes)
Disadvantage aura: attacks targeting you or adjacent allies this round gain disadvantage (Encompassing Shadow bottom); advantage on an attack (Primal Duality top)
Chain attack: -1 Attack / +2 Range per enemy already attacked, each next target within range 2 of the previous (Chain Lightning top)
Attacks targeted relative to the heal target: all enemies adjacent to it, all enemies at exactly range 2 from it (Eye of the Hurricane top)
Map features: create a Damage 2 trap and damage 1 to enemies adjacent to it (Gravel Guard bottom); create 1-hex hazardous terrain in the target's featureless hex (Prismatic Barrage top)
Damage negation for you or an adjacent ally, 2 slots (Obsidian Shards bottom); direct damage 5 without an attack (Primal Duality top)
Consume-converted area: consuming Fire turns a single-target attack into a 3-hex area (Pulsing Cores top)
Summons: Chromatic Construct (Elemental Juggernaut), Elemental Conduit (Ethereal Manifestation)
unclear: Magma Scales top: whether the consume Air row (Disarm, range 1, infuse Air) is part of the grant (the ally disarms an enemy adjacent to it) or performed by you; it is printed under the granted Move with no connector line. GHS nests it inside the grant.

Gravel Guard top: whether 'Muddle: target all, range 1' is granted (enemies adjacent to the ally) or yours (enemies adjacent to you); it is printed inside the grant block. GHS nests it inside the grant.
Winter's Edge bottom: whether 'target 2 allies, range 3' applies to both Strengthen and Bless or only to Bless (the pill follows the Bless icon). GHS attaches it to Bless only.

Split element icons (Pulsing Cores, Obsidian Shards, Winter's Edge, Pragmatic Reinforcement, Duskstorm, Elemental Juggernaut, Confluence of Elements): read as 'one of the two elements' following GHS; the red X on a split consume icon (Pragmatic Reinforcement, Duskstorm) sits on one half only, so check the 2e rule that a split consume means either element.
Lingering Essence top: persistent with no lost icon and no slots; when it ends (end of scenario?) is a rules question.
